columns.retrieval_gloss: Federal Information Processing Standards code identifying the U.S. state associated with the wildfire record. Values are 3-digit strings corresponding to state codes.

columns.retrieval_gloss: The name of the county in California where the wildfire occurred, derived from FIPS code mapping.

columns.retrieval_gloss: The area burned by a wildfire, measured in acres. Used for filtering large fires and ranking incidents by magnitude.

columns.retrieval_gloss: The calendar year in which the wildfire incident occurred. Used for temporal filtering and grouping of fire records.

columns.retrieval_gloss: A numeric code identifying the entity or agency responsible for the fire incident. Likely maps to a specific land management organization or jurisdiction.
